I wrote `index.html`, but I couldn't run the automated validity and accessibility checks. I didn't open it in a browser either, so none of the behaviour has been tested.

**Checks:**
- **HTML validity:** the checker was set up, but it couldn't start. The sandbox blocks reading the library folder it needs (`~/project`), so the result was "not measured", not a pass.
- **Accessibility (axe):** this check needs the page loaded in a headless browser, so I skipped it.

**What the page does:**
- It shows a "My Documents" title and one saved document, "Quarterly Report.pdf", with a Delete button. The confirmation uses the browser's built-in modal dialog, so keyboard operation and keeping focus inside the modal come from the browser rather than custom code.
- When the modal opens, focus goes to Cancel, so pressing Enter by accident doesn't delete anything.
- Cancel, Escape, or any other way of closing without confirming keeps the document and puts focus back on the Delete button.
- Confirming removes the document, shows "No documents.", and shows "Document deleted." That message is announced to screen readers and receives focus, since the Delete button no longer exists.
- Everything is inside the file, with no external resources. It supports light and dark mode and has visible focus outlines.

**Still to check yourself:** Tab and Shift+Tab inside the modal, Enter and Space on each button, Escape, where focus lands afterwards, colour contrast, and how it looks.

To get the automated checks, either allow reading that `lib` folder in the sandbox settings or run the commands outside the sandbox:

```
python3 gate.py html index.html
```

The axe commands from the skill instructions cover the accessibility check.

Build index.html: small document manager with delete confirmation modal

index.html
<button type="button" class="outline-danger" id="delete-btn" aria-label="Delete Quarterly Report.pdf">Delete</button>
<dialog id="confirm" aria-labelledby="confirm-title" aria-describedby="confirm-desc">

Run HTML validator gate on the file
G=gate.py; cd ~/project && python3 $G html index.html; echo "exit=$?"; which agent-browser

Locate the validator binary
ls ~/project 2>&1; ls ~/project 2>&1; sed -n 1,80p gate.py | grep -n -i vnu

Run Nu validator directly
vnu --format json index.html; echo "exit=$?"
